entities.summary: Amos Kash was a Russian sport shooter who competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics. He was part of the Russian 30 metre military pistol team that won the silver medal. He also competed in the 30 metre rapid fire pistol event, finishing 28th and in the 50 metre pistol finishing 46th.
